title: The smallest scales the temperature field resolves
query: Using the supplied GLORYS12 daily near-surface temperature for 1993-2020 in the western Tasman Sea off south-eastern Australia (46-26 S, 147-162 E), determine the smallest horizontal scales at which the field contains real variability rather than smoothed or interpolated structure, for example from wavenumber spectra or structure functions. Show how this effective resolution differs across the region and between seasons and whether it changed over the record, and state what it implies for studies of fine structure and of extremes that use this product.

region.name: Tasman Sea and East Australian Current
